item.title: Pseudo-Jahn–Teller Effect-Mediated Medium-Spin (S = 3/2) Fe for Robust Fe–N Bonds in Acidic Oxygen Reduction and Fuel Cells
item.description:
اثر شبه یان-تلر با القای بیسموت، اسپین متوسط Fe(III) را تثبیت کرده و پیوند Fe-N را در کاهش اکسیژن اسیدی و پیل سوختی تقویت می‌کند.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Introducing p-block Bi adjacent to FeN4 triggers pseudo-Jahn–Teller distortion, stabilizing medium-spin Fe(III) with an empty dx2–y2 orbital that accepts nitrogen lone pairs, strengthening Fe–N bonds against acid demetalation. This yields 3-fold higher Fe retention, 720 mW cm–2 peak power, and 90% current retention over 150 h, establishing p-J-T engineering as a new strategy for durable PGM-free fuel cell catalysts.
🏷 Fe-N-C catalyst · oxygen reduction · PEMFC · pseudo-Jahn-Teller effect · demetalation

Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in a controlled-release polymerization strategy creating a gel polymer electrode via electrolyte-triggered secondary gelation. This quasi-solid design combines solid-state polysulfide blocking with liquid electrolyte kinetics, enabling stress dissipation and ion transport. It achieves 812.8 mAh g⁻¹ at 2 C, 1000-cycle stability, and a 1.7 Ah pouch cell, advancing practical lithium-sulfur batteries.

💡 Molecular tailoring of succinonitrile creates SGa plasticizer with retained amide groups and gauche conformation, suppressing self-aggregation and optimizing Na+ solvation. This yields high ionic conductivity (0.352 mS cm–1), Na+ transference number 0.71, and stable Na3N-rich interphase, enabling 1500-cycle stability at 4.5 V. The work demonstrates molecular customization as an effective strategy for high-performance solid-state sodium metal batteries.

Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 SRAM enables round-the-clock lithium extraction from low-grade brines via dissolved electron carriers that mediate electron transfer to dispersed olivine iron phosphate, suppressing competing-ion intercalation. It achieves high selectivity (Li⁺/Na⁺ 700, Li⁺/Mg²⁺ 2400) and rate (40 mA mmol⁻¹), while carriers double as chemical energy storage, buffering intermittent solar input without external batteries—enabling off-grid, day–night operation validated on 50-L raw brine.
🏷 lithium extraction · redox adsorption · solar-powered · olivine iron phosphate · brine
